main.description: An account's profile as one app shows it: that app's profile record, folded over the records it extends. A convenience for prototyping and for apps that would rather not resolve identities themselves; the `@omote-social/profiles` library does the same work from the records, with no service in between.

collection.description: The app's profile record collection, e.g. `social.grain.actor.profile`.

avatar.description: Served by the account's own PDS.

banner.description: Served by the account's own PDS.

chain.description: The records that were read and applied, lowest precedence first. The requested collection is last when its record exists.

sources.description: Where each field came from. A field no record in the chain mentions is absent here.

collection.description: The record the value came from, or, when `hidden`, the record whose `null` removed it.

hidden.description: True when a record set the field to `null` over a value one of its bases had, so the app shows nothing.
